encoding_notes: Encoded from Wayback snapshot 2025-07-19; live Wiley page Cloudflare-blocked to WebFetch and Apify headless render. Guide footer: 'Author Guidelines Updated 15 February 2021'.
Free Format submission: journal prescribes no font, size, line spacing, margins, page size, or line numbers -> all layout values null/none.
Consensus Statement category omitted (no clean article_types enum slot).

Original Article length is PAGE-based, not word-based: page charges apply to articles exceeding 8 pages; any article exceeding 6 final published pages charged GBP 125/page (a page ~5,400 characters incl. spaces, excl. tables/figures). Cannot be expressed as manuscript_max_words.

Combined figure/table caps not representable in separate figures_max/tables_max: Original Article = 8 figures AND/OR tables total (combined); Review = 'keep to a minimum' (no number); Letter = either 1 Figure OR 1 Table (mutually exclusive). All set null; combined caps documented here.
Mandatory 'Perspective' paragraph (<=200 words) at end of Discussion for Original Article and Review — no schema field.

References: AMA style, superscript Arabic numerals, numbered in order of appearance; journal names abbreviated NLM-style (sample: 'J Comp Neurol'); sample refs omit DOI so include_doi=false; et al. threshold not stated.
Peer review is single-blind -> double_blind false; no anonymization/blinded file required.

Figure formats and DPI live in a linked 'electronic artwork guidelines' PDF (media.wiley.com) not fetched; for peer review 'a wide variety of formats, sizes, and resolutions are accepted' -> formats [] and min_dpi null.
Figure legends required BOTH beneath each image at upload AND as a complete list in the text -> legends_location=figure_legends_section.

tables placement: main-document order lists tables after references (grouped_end); free format allows single-file embedding at initial submission, but figures/tables MUST be separate files at revision stage.

figures separate_files=false: 'Parts of the Manuscript' lists figures as a separate part, but Free Format explicitly allows a single document at initial submission; separate files required only at revision.

declarations required=conflict_of_interest (must state even if none) + data_availability (required for all accepted manuscripts); funding/ethics_approval/patient_consent/trial_registration are conditional. Keywords max also stated as 'maximum of 8'.
ISSN 1600-0838 (online) derived from canonical URL slug 16000838; not stated in guide prose.
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
